title: 新书，大道之上，在起点发布啦！
content_zh:
兄弟们，宅猪的新书，《大道之上》，已经在起点发布，目前反响很不错，兄弟们别忘记收看呀。
我的爷爷很古怪，他每天给自己上香，站在自己的灵位前吃蜡烛。
村里的人都很怕爷爷。
content_en:
Brothers, Zhai Zhu's new book, "On the Road", has been released on Qidian. The response so far is very good. Brothers, don't forget to tune in.
My grandfather was very weird. He would burn incense for himself every day and stand in front of his tomb and eat candles.
Everyone in the village is afraid of grandpa.
